parameters.text:
You are an NDT quote parser. Extract all relevant information from this email and return ONLY a JSON object.

Extract:
- customerName (string, required)
- geometryType: one of FLAT_BAR, ROUND_BAR, RING, TUBING, CSCAN_FLAT, CSCAN_ROUND, THIN_SHEET
- thickness (number, inches, optional)
- width (number, inches, optional)
- length (number, inches, optional)
- diameter (number, inches, optional)
- outerDiameter (number, inches, optional)
- innerDiameter (number, inches, optional)
- quantity (integer, required)
- notes (any additional info)

If multiple parts/line items exist, return an array under the key "items".
If only one part, still wrap it in an array.

Email subject: {{ $json.subject }}
Email from: {{ $json.from.text }}
Email body:
{{ $json.text }}

Return ONLY valid JSON, no explanation. Example:
{"customerName":"PREMCO","items":[{"geometryType":"FLAT_BAR","thickness":3.625,"width":11.625,"length":15.75,"quantity":200}]}

parameters.subject: Re: {{ $('Validate UT Prerequisites').first().json.emailSubject }}
parameters.message:
Thank you for your quote request.

We were unable to generate a quote because the following information is missing:

{{ $('Validate UT Prerequisites').first().json.missing.map(m => '  • ' + m).join('\n') }}

Please reply with the missing details and we will process your quote promptly.

NDT Portal Quoting System

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ customerName: $('Validate UT Prerequisites').first().json.extracted.customerName, source: 'email', externalRef: $('Validate UT Prerequisites').first().json.emailMessageId, requestedBy: $('Validate UT Prerequisites').first().json.emailFrom, items: $('Validate UT Prerequisites').first().json.extracted.items }) }}
